description: Fix WebSocket feed _WsState NameError. The feed.py module uses _WsState.OPEN but never imports or defines it, causing runtime crashes. Replace with 'not ws.closed' (a boolean property available on websockets v12.0+) in is_connected property and _heartbeat_loop method.
steps: Read c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin\try12\backend\app\services\market_data\feed.py to confirm current _WsState usage locations (line 234 in is_connected property: 'return self._ws is not None and (self._ws.state == _WsState.OPEN)', and line 291 in _heartbeat_loop: 'if self._ws and (self._ws.state == _WsState.OPEN):').
Replace line 234 'return self._ws is not None and (self._ws.state == _WsState.OPEN)' with 'return self._ws is not None and not self._ws.closed'.
Replace line 291 'if self._ws and (self._ws.state == _WsState.OPEN):' with 'if self._ws and not self._ws.closed:'.
Verify the fix does not introduce syntax errors by checking the file parses correctly.
Commit the fix with message 'fix: replace undefined _WsState with ws.closed check in feed.py'.
